name: IQ test: name the coverage
blurb: Thirteen WNBA ball screens. Read the screener's man and your man, then name the coverage.

FR-IQ4.t: Basketball IQ Test #4 - How to Read Ballscreen Coverages
FR-IQ4.who: The Film Room · former Big 12 player

m.title: Coverage 1: Sky at Fever
m.q: Watch the man guarding the screener and your man. What coverage is the defense in?
m.ans: The screener's defender gets level with the screener, on the same line, and stays flat in front of the ball so you can't turn the corner.

m.title: Coverage 2: Fever at Storm
m.q: Watch the man guarding the screener and your man. What coverage is the defense in?
m.ans: Your man goes under the screener so the two defenders can trade matchups without losing leverage.

m.ans: The screener's defender stays back with a gap between him and the screener, below the roller, giving himself room to react.

m.q: Watch the man guarding the screener and your man. What coverage is the defense in?
m.ans: The screener's defender comes up the floor, hugged up to the screener, to get in the ball handler's way while your man gets over.
